description: Talk about a diamond in the rough!  This home has a ridiculous amount of potential.  Located just off of Mission Inn - in a historically designated area, built in 1910, this 3 bedroom, 2 bath home (1 inside and one half bath on the back porch) 1927 square foot Victorian has tons of original woodwork and porches and nooks and crannies galore.  Property currently does not have heating or air conditioning.  Does not qualify for FHA/VA financing, unless doing a rehab loan and Conventional may be questionable. Perfect for investors.  Driveway at the back to a former carriage house, which is in disrepair.  May be perfect for doing a second unit and having separation.  On a large lot.
